description: What a buyer reads of its purchase: the purchase, its receipt once sealed, the method's public result once fulfilment won, and what runx holds for it. Never the seller's run, step outputs or grants, and never a held value.

balance_micro.description: What the reading account's runx balance holds, in micro-USD, while the purchase can still be paid from it. Never shown to a buyer key.

failure.description: Why a refund won. Present only after refund won.

leases.description: Each resource runx holds for the purchase's buyer, once fulfilment won.

receipt.description: runx's signed purchase receipt, once sealed: what a claim presents.

title: PurchaseRead
